_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, parsley, mustard, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad
